title: Rate of weathering of Cold Lake Blend diluted bitumen at different water temperatures taking into consideration uncontrolled environmental factors
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00400D, Paper

Thomas King, Brian Robinson, Jennifer Mason, Michel Boufadel
The rate of weathering of Cold Lake Blend diluted bitumen in floating microcosms in an experimental flume tank was monitored over time (0, 6, 24, 48, 72, 96, and 168 hours) under controlled temperature conditions (4, 10, 15 and 25 °C).
